contract.instructions: Prerequisites (plan §7.2 exact table): DB, B7, B8, A12, R1.0, R1.2. RED test (§7.6): materialize-ranking-v3-corpus.test.mjs — corpus_binds_all_tuning_tasks_and_contains_raw_provider_authority_only; expected failure before implementation: tasks are missing, held-out appears, or normalized fields are stored; minimal passing behavior: exact tuning coverage, target binding, and raw-only provider evidence. The focused command targets a file that does NOT exist at base (verified) — unverifiable-at-base. Plan §6.3 fixes the raw provider authority field set: serviceClass, providerKey, rerankerIdentity, rerankerProjectionIdentity, providerConfigurationDigest, providerRequestContractSha256, baselineAdmissionSet digest, request candidate order, complete returned candidate order, finite raw scores, request/response digests, timeout/failure outcome. Corpus source verified at base: cross-repository-v3.manifest.json holds 50 tuning tasks (8/8/8/8/9/9 across the six tuning families) and 51 held-out tasks.
